name: Barbarian audit: Battering Ram's periodic armor-penetration trigger fires with the right value (#2049)
contract: Battering Ram rank 1 (561326, EffectBasePoints 9 DieSides 1 = 10) and rank 2 (561331, EffectBasePoints 19 DieSides 1 = 20) are each a single SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE (227, EffectAmplitude 10000 ms, EffectTriggerSpell 561362). AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellWithValueAuraTick (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) fires every 10 s and casts 561362 with CustomSpellValues SPELLVALUE_BASE_POINT0 = GetAmount(), overriding 561362's own effect 0 base points (which are otherwise a placeholder EffectBasePoints -1 -> 0) with the parent's amount. 561362 effect 0 carries SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT (280 -- the array comment in SpellAuraEffects.cpp mislabels it MOD_TARGET_ARMOR_PCT, but SpellAuraDefines.h names index 280 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT), which Unit::CalcArmorReducedDamage reads via GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT, ...) to reduce the victim's effective armor -- exactly the tooltip's 'bypass $s1% of enemy armor'. 561362 also carries EquippedItemClass 2 / EquippedItemSubClassMask 354 (two-handed Axe/Mace/Polearm/Sword), so inside CalcArmorReducedDamage's lambda the bonus is gated on Player::HasItemFitToSpellRequirements(561362), i.e. the attacker must have a two-handed weapon equipped -- this generically implements 'while a two-handed weapon is equipped' and needs no script. That gear-dependent damage-formula outcome is not exercised here (it would require equipping a specific weapon); this scenario instead proves the trigger mechanism itself: the periodic tick fires on schedule and transplants the correct override value into 561362's live aura.

steps.label: Rank 1's amplitude is the documented 10 s
The periodic tick applies 561362 with the overridden value 10
The periodic tick applies 561362 with the overridden value 20
